Fuzzer for gRPC HTTP/2 request header generation and HPACK decoding checks.

# Purpose
This file is a libFuzzer test for the gRPC HTTP/2 request header generator in `fd_grpc_codec.h`. It defines [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) to set up the Firedancer runtime for fuzzing, disable log backtraces, and make info-level logs fail fast. The main entry point, [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>), reads structured input data and uses it to build a `fd_grpc_req_hdrs_t` request with a host, path, bearer token, HTTPS flag, port, and version string.

The test then calls `fd_grpc_h2_gen_request_hdrs` to generate encoded HTTP/2 headers into an `fd_h2_rbuf_t` buffer, and it decodes the result with `fd_hpack_rd_t` to verify each header field. It checks the required gRPC headers such as `:method`, `:scheme`, `:path`, `:authority`, `te`, `content-type`, `user-agent`, and `authorization`, and it confirms that the authorization value uses the `Bearer ` prefix. This file therefore validates both the encoding logic and the exact header content produced by the gRPC request header generator.
